_comment: EXT-63, arm 25 — 12 h FULL STACK: canonical + LV-1 (seed frame) + LV-2 (carry
de-mean) + LV-4 (frame-invariant carry screen) + LV-5 (within-epoch mu).  Graded
against arm 24 on the same window.
LADDER SO FAR (1 h settled window, 20-60 min, GIM reference 32.24 TECU):
arm 13 canonical        settled mean 17.45  sd  3.71  range 12.2
arm 19 +LV-1+LV-2       settled mean 37.43  sd  4.98  range 14.3
arm 21 +LV-4            settled mean 36.93  sd 15.53  range 54.1  (lag-1 limit cycle)
arm 23 +LV-5            settled mean 35.24  sd  4.69  range 13.9  end 32.68
The level defect closes (17.45 -> 35.24 against 32.24) with the oscillation removed
and the carry fully admitted (97.5 % folded vs 43.5 % on the canonical posture).
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- a00 holds near GIM over 12 h rather than settling and then walking: predict the
hour-mean stays inside ~28-38 TECU for every hour after the first, with no
monotone trend.  A slow walk means the designed authority (the per-epoch a00
anchor) is being outvoted by the newly admitted carry information over long
horizons -- which an hour cannot see and which would be the next card.
- Residual common mode (LV-5's own readout) stays ~1e-2 m over 12 h.  If mean
|resid| grows with the window, the prepass candidate set and PASS B's folded set
are diverging and the fix is a two-pass PASS B, not a threshold.
- LV-4 erases stay ~1 % of checks; a climb means the peer-relative scale is
tracking a real per-station instability -- a finding about the network.
- deg-1 dipole: it GREW with the level fix at 1 h (end 20.11 -> 31.30).  Predict it
stabilizes rather than growing without bound; if it keeps climbing over 12 h, the
clustered-spread mechanism is being fed by the admitted carry and needs its own
card before this posture is promoted anywhere.
- Grade the level on network_vtec_sh_health.csv a00_tecu ONLY (network_ionosphere.csv
is frame-broken by construction, and LV-1 deliberately moves the seed it omits).
